sources.entry: Zammad - Easy to use but powerful support and ticketing system. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Ruby/deb
Zammad | Web-based helpdesk and customer support system

summary.one_liner: Zammad is a web-based, open-source helpdesk and customer support system for handling inquiries across email, chat, telephone and social media.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Zammad as a web-based open-source helpdesk and customer support platform that streamlines customer communication across channels such as email, chat, telephone and social media. It is licensed under the GNU AGPLv3 and its source code is hosted on GitHub. The README says the project is owned by the Zammad Foundation and developed by Zammad GmbH together with the community. The Status section lists Toolchain, Docker container images, Helm chart for Kubernetes, and DEB/RPM downloads, but the values are blank in the README text. Installation, screenshots, developer manual, and REST API are linked from the README but not described in it. The README itself does not give detailed feature lists or setup steps.
use_cases: consolidate email, chat, phone and social media inquiries
coordinate a support team on customer requests
provide customer support via a web interface
notable: Owned by the Zammad Foundation, independent of commercial providers such as Zammad GmbH
Multi-channel support: email, chat, telephone and social media
Offers Docker container images, a Helm chart for Kubernetes, and DEB/RPM packages
Has a REST API and developer manual per the README links
caveats: README gives no setup commands; installation is referred to external documentation
The company offers a paid cloud service and suggests it as the easiest way to operate Zammad
Setup, configuration, backup and update are described as complex in the README's marketing text
